scope: Myowol Nightwalk design, the Lastbell-named current prototype, and the shared Myogwirok draft; market cases, core fun, detailed expedition mechanics, online hardcore design, and replayability

implemented: eight-direction free movement and mouse aiming
telegraphed cone melee attacks, shove, crouch, and blocking
four safe zones and three distance-based danger tiers
enemy-specific weaknesses and rival scavenger AI
gate key objective, escape and retirement

market_cases.name: Escape From Duckov
market_cases.metric: about 10,700 English Steam reviews at 93% positive
market_cases.lesson: single-player PvE extraction can lower the PvP barrier while preserving loot and return decisions

market_cases.name: ZERO Sievert
market_cases.metric: more than 600,000 copies sold; about 8,100 English Steam reviews at 85% positive
market_cases.metric_type: official store claim and platform review snapshot
market_cases.lesson: top-down pixel extraction has demonstrated commercial demand without multiplayer

market_cases.name: Hunt: Showdown 1896
market_cases.lesson: replaceable hunters, equipment loss, sound and PvPvE can support a long-running online extraction game

market_cases.name: Project Zomboid
market_cases.metric: about 161,300 English Steam reviews at 93% positive
market_cases.lesson: top-down knowledge mastery, permadeath and multiplayer can sustain long-term interest when supported by broad systemic play

market_cases.name: Risk of Rain 2
market_cases.metric: more than 4 million Steam copies; 57% of players over 10 hours
market_cases.lesson: run-specific item combinations and co-op support replay better than map randomization alone

market_cases.name: Phasmophobia
market_cases.lesson: shared deduction and player knowledge can be a strong form of co-op progression

market_cases.name: Albion Online
market_cases.lesson: spatially separated risk levels let players choose when to accept full-loss play

warning_case.name: The Cycle: Frontier
warning_case.result: service ended after initial attention declined and the game was no longer financially viable
warning_case.lesson: servers, anti-cheat, matchmaking, reconnects, audit logs and live retention are core online scope

measurement_caveats: sales, cumulative players, daily active accounts and review counts are different measures and must not be combined
English Steam reviews do not represent total buyers or Korean players
successful comparables show demand for individual patterns, not causation or Myowol Nightwalk sales potential
the Korean-folklore and cat-dosa combination has not been market-tested
the prototype has not yet completed human fun, completion, retry or retention tests
recommended_sequence: finish and observe the single-player objective-to-escape-to-inheritance loop
add a small run-build layer, one cursed relic and three authored encounters
run a two-player authoritative synchronization test
test four-player solo PvPvE with one small map before adding parties or an economy
choose single-player, co-op or PvPvE as the product only from observed repeat play

additions: three Myoan talismans: tracking, true-form sight, and sound sight
one cursed relic called the Eclipse Bell
one optional Myowol Nightwalk extension after obtaining the gate key
one result screen that explains death or successful return
next_playable_slice.stop_condition: connect all additions into one return on the existing map, make the planned behavior measurable, then stop adding content and observe five players
non_goals: a second map or full procedural generation
crafting, player trading, guilds, seasons, or battle passes
complex body-part injuries or a large item economy
